releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.3.8 (Build 75):
• Calendar Navigation & Status Bar Safe Clearance: Header lowered below status bars and punch-holes with back button navigation.
• Zero Dock Collision: Enhanced bottom scroll padding and spacer so events and tasks sit cleanly above the floating navigation dock.
• Liquid Droplet Architecture: Day drawer and calendar cells restyled into liquid glass droplets with specular micro-sheens.
• Category Filter Layout: Horizontal scroll with zero text truncation for all event filters.
• Clean Separation: Full Calendar moved to More Hub; Home calendar header launches floating quick agenda popup.
